name: videohub
description: VideoHub — video & movie discovery, authorized downloads, and an AI recommendation agent.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@videohub/types && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/config && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/api && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/web
scripts.build:shared: npm run build --workspace=@videohub/types && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/config
scripts.build:api: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@videohub/web
